Messages.Author: Emmit Svenson
Messages.Body:
In a single turn, I play Social Ladder on a vampire, then play Descent
Into Darkness with that vampire, then choose not to burn the DID.
Presumably the out-of-play Social Ladder's effect does not trigger. If
I burn the DID in a later influence phase, does the Social Ladder's
effect trigger?

Relevant card texts:

Social Ladder
Master
Put this card on a ready vampire you control. During your next
influence phase, remove this vampire from the game and move all the
blood counters from that vampire to an older vampire in your
uncontrolled region.

Descent into Darkness
Action
Obtenebration
Blood Cost: 1
+1 stealth action

Turn the acting vampire and any cards on him or her face down, out of
play (breaking any temporary control affects). Put this card on him or
her (in play). During your influence phase, move 2 blood to this
face-down vampire from the blood bank, and you can choose to burn this
card to return the vampire to play, tapped.

As above, but the vampire is untapped when he or she returns to play

If the vampire has more blood on him than his capacity from Descent
into Darkness, then when you bring him back into play and use Social
Ladder on him, does the excess blood burn off before the effect of
Social Ladder or can Social Ladder take advantage of the excess blood
on the vampire?

I am sure it drains off, but I think that is crux of the question.
